lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 40 high-luminance circular spots arranged in a grid-like configuration posterior to the branchial region, distributed across five horizontal rows and eight vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot alignments to form a coordinate-based matrix across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, each defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal aspect and shadow on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three distinct remoras (Echeneidae) attached to or swimming in the immediate proximity of the mid-lateral flank and pectoral fin.
